items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Okay. Smith. He was for the Puerto Rico Steelship Company. He was superintendent.

ctx.x: With my brother-in-law. You understand? What kind of work? Longshore. Longshore. My brother-in-law was a boss out there. And whenever I had a job, like tonight, I'd have a job, I'd get off at 12 o'clock today. That's it. That's it, brother? He'd leave me off. That's it, brother? Uh-huh. He'd say, hey, so too. What was his name?
Okay. Smith. He was for the Puerto Rico Steelship Company. He was superintendent.
And I'd play when I'd play them carnival parades and carnival balls. You understand? I had a pay list. It's not long. Is that right?
